event_records.description: The McCain campaign and the Obama campaign each have the scheduled debate on their calendars and are internally deliberating whether to publicly confirm participation.

mccain_campaign.name: McCain campaign
mccain_campaign.persona_brief:
You are McCain campaign.
The McCain campaign is aware of the scheduled first presidential debate at the University of Mississippi on September 26, 2008. They have not yet publicly confirmed Senator McCain's participation for that specific debate, though they have previously indicated general willingness to debate. They are considering the timing and format.

obama_campaign.name: Obama campaign
obama_campaign.persona_brief:
You are Obama campaign.
The Obama campaign is aware of the scheduled first presidential debate at the University of Mississippi on September 26, 2008. They have not yet publicly confirmed Senator Obama's participation for that specific debate, though they have previously indicated general willingness to debate. They are considering the timing and format.

resolution.question: Will the McCain and Obama campaigns both publicly confirm their candidates' participation in the first 2008 presidential debate at the University of Mississippi before the scheduled debate day?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that both the McCain campaign and the Obama campaign have issued a public statement (e.g., press release, official campaign announcement, or public comment by a campaign spokesperson) confirming their candidate's participation in the first 2008 presidential debate at the University of Mississippi before September 26, 2008. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff of 2008-09-26T12:00:00-05:00.
